name: A compacted context leaves Boop a little lost
case: The agent's tests fail a minute in, and three minutes later its context fills up and is compacted, so it carries on from a summary and gets the tests passing. Boop looks lost for a moment, where was it: a confused, curious, baffled or calm face, no finish, maybe a puzzled sound. When the turn finishes well two minutes later, that's a success.
why: The view lines a compaction (EventLine.compacted); PERSONALITY's Example: confused, looking in a sound, once; characters/boop/steering/mood/confused.md
